notes.title: THE ONE YEAR ANNIVERSARY OF PAIN APPROACHES
notes.content:
Bon soir, freaks, it has been almost one full year since BLOOD WIZARD ODYSSEY leapt from the recesses of my brainosphere directly onto your personal computers and splashed hot wet blood all over you and yours. SO. I wanted to give you a "Head's Up" about some things that are coming on December 12th.

1) SOUNDTRACK. I will be releasing the original Blood Wizard Odyssey soundtrack, something that has been requested of me several times but took me this long because I am terrible. This will not include the public domain music that appears in the game.

2) UPDATE. I will be updating the game to fix all the more obvious bugs that I realistically could have fixed shortly after the game was released but, again, I am terrible. And the wait makes it all the sweeter... Sincerest apologies to the multitudes of Blood Wizard Odyssey speedrunners who will no longer have access to the level skips I forgot to delete.

3) Uhhh idk. Check out the twitter @BloodWizardGame, I'm planning to post some of my progress on the sequel soon. The sequel, title yet to be determined, will be much longer with a grander story, more complex combat, more blood, more ogres, less Gnosticism, more party members, and approximately the same amount of love ❤️ 💕 💖 🥰 

Gnomepunk out
